analyzed: teṣām api dakṣiṇatas bhagavān ārya avalokiteśvaraḥ sarva alaṅkāra vibhūṣitaḥ śarad kāṇḍa gauraḥ padmāsana upaviṣṭaḥ vāma hastena padmam gṛhītvā dakṣiṇa hastena vara daḥ tasya api dakṣiṇatas bhagavatī pāṇḍara vāsinī padma hastā dakṣiṇena hastena bhagavantam śākyamunim vandamānā padmāsana upaniṣaṇṇā jaṭā makuṭa dhāriṇī śveta paṭṭavastra nivastā paṭṭa aṃśuka uttarāsaṅginī kṛṣṇa bhasma tri muṇḍī kṛt

original: evaṃ bodhisattvāḥ ṣoḍaśa kāryāḥ | tadyathā | samantabhadraḥ kṣitigarbho gaganagañjaḥ sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhī • apāyajaho maitreyaś camaravyagrahastaḥ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ nirīkṣamāṇo vimalamatir vimalaketuḥ sudhanaś candraprabho vimalakīrtiḥ sarvavyādhicikitsakaḥ sarvadharmīśvararājo lokagatir mahāmatiḥ patidharaś ceti | ete ṣoḍaśa mahābodhisattvāḥ prasannamūrtayaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā lekhyāḥ || 2.141 ||
analyzed: evam bodhisattvāḥ ṣoḍaśa kāryāḥ tat yathā samantabhadraḥ kṣitigarbhaḥ gaganagañjaḥ sarva nīvaraṇa viṣkambhī apāyajahaḥ maitreyaḥ camara vyagra hastaḥ buddham bhagavantam nirīkṣamāṇaḥ vimalamatiḥ vimalaketuḥ sudhanaḥ candraprabhaḥ vimalakīrtiḥ sarva vyādhi cikitsakaḥ sarva dharmīśvara rājaḥ lokagatiḥ mahāmatiḥ patidharaḥ ca iti ete ṣoḍaśa mahābodhisattvāḥ prasanna mūrtayaḥ sarva alaṅkāra bhūṣitāḥ lekhyāḥ

original: pradhānavidyārājā vidyārājñī • abjakule rūpakamudrāsu ca yathāsmarata āgamataś ca yathāsthāneṣu cāśeṣā lekhyāḥ | ante ca sthāne caturasrākāraṃ sthānaṃ sthāpayet padmapuṣpasaṃstṛtam | yena smaritā vidyā devatā te 'smin sthāne tiṣṭhantv iti || 2.142 ||
analyzed: pradhāna vidyā rājā vidyā rājñī abjakule rūpaka mudrāsu ca yathā smarataḥ āgamataḥ ca yathā sthāneṣu ca aśeṣāḥ lekhyāḥ ante ca sthāne catur asra ākāram sthānam sthāpayet padma puṣpa saṃstṛtam yena smaritā vidyā devatā te smin sthāne tiṣṭhantu iti

original: evaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve bhagavataḥ śākyamuner dvau pratyekabuddhau gandhamādana upāriṣṭaś ceti | evaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ {B38v} maṇḍalaṃ sarvataḥ praveśadvāraṃ kāryam | bhagavataḥ śākyamuner vāmapārśve aparau dvau pratyekabuddhau candanaḥ siddhaś ceti ālekhyau | teṣām adhastād dvau mahāśrāvakau mahākāśyapo mahākātyāyanaś cālekhyau || 2.143 ||
analyzed: evam dakṣiṇe pārśve bhagavataḥ śākyamuneḥ dvau pratyekabuddhau gandhamādanaḥ upāriṣṭaḥ ca iti evam prāc mukham maṇḍalam sarvatas praveśa dvāram kāryam bhagavataḥ śākyamuneḥ vāma pārśve aparau dvau pratyekabuddhau candanaḥ siddhaḥ ca iti ālekhyau teṣām adhastāt dvau mahāśrāvakau mahākāśyapaḥ mahākātyāyanaḥ ca ālekhyau

original: teṣām api vāmataḥ āryavajrapāṇiḥ kuvalayaśyāmābhaḥ prasannamūrtiḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ | dakṣiṇe cāmaravyagrahastaḥ vāmena krodhamūrtihasto vajramuṣṭiḥ | vajrāṅkuśī vajraśṛṅkhalā subāhur vajrasenā {S41} yathāveṣacihnasthānāsanasarvavidyārājñarājñīsaparivārarūpamudrādiṣu yathāsmaraṇā lekhyāḥ | teṣām api vāmataś caturasrākāra-mubhayavajramudrāṃ likhet | likhya ca vaktavyam | yatra sthāne na smaritā vidyāgaṇās te 'tra sthāne tiṣṭantu | iti || 2.144 ||
analyzed: teṣām api vāmatas ārya vajrapāṇiḥ kuvalaya śyāma ābhaḥ prasanna mūrtiḥ sarva alaṅkāra bhūṣitaḥ dakṣiṇe cāmara vyagra hastaḥ vāmena krodhamūrti hastaḥ vajra muṣṭiḥ vajra aṅkuśī vajra śṛṅkhalā subāhuḥ vajrasenā yathā veṣa cihna sthāna āsana sarva vidyā rājña rājñī sa parivāra rūpa mudrā ādiṣu yathā smaraṇāḥ lekhyāḥ teṣām api vāmatas catur asra ākāram ubhaya vajra mudrām likhet likhya ca vaktavyam yatra sthāne na smarit

original: teṣām upariṣṭāt ṣaṭpāramitā bhagavatī māmakī • ālekhyāḥ sarvālaṅkāravibhūṣitāś ca tāḥ prasannamūrtayaḥ | teṣām apy upariṣṭād aṣṭau • uṣṇīṣarājānaḥ samantajvālamālākulāḥ | mudrāṃ baddhvā svakasvakāni mahārājacakravartirūpāṇi ālekhyāni kanakavarṇasuprasannendriyāṇi sarvālaṅkāravibhūṣitāni | īṣat tathāgatapratimadṛṣṭiyātāni | tadyathā cakravartyuṣṇīṣo 'bhyudgatoṣṇīṣaḥ sitātapatro {B39r} jayoṣṇīṣaḥ kamaloṣṇīṣo vijayoṣṇīṣas tejorāśi • unnatoṣṇīṣa iti || 2.145 ||
analyzed: teṣām upariṣṭāt ṣaḍ pāramitāḥ bhagavatī māmakī ālekhyāḥ sarva alaṅkāra vibhūṣitāḥ ca tāḥ prasanna mūrtayaḥ teṣām api upariṣṭāt aṣṭau uṣṇīṣa rājānaḥ samanta jvāla mālā ākulāḥ mudrām baddhvā svaka svakāni mahā rāja cakravarti rūpāṇi ālekhyāni kanaka varṇa su prasanna indriyāṇi sarva alaṅkāra vibhūṣitāni īṣat tathāgata pratima dṛṣṭi yātāni tat yathā cakravarti uṣṇīṣaḥ bhyudgata uṣṇīṣaḥ sita

original: ete • aṣṭa • uṣṇīṣarājānaḥ pratyekabuddhānāṃ vāmata ālekhyā | dvāre ca bodhisattvau kāryau | praveśatadakṣiṇato lokātikrāntagāmī nāma jaṭāmakuṭadhārī saumyamūrtiḥ | dakṣiṇahastena • akṣasūtraṃ gṛhītvā vāmahastena kamaṇḍaluṃ dvārābhimukha īṣadbhrukuṭīvadanaḥ | vāmataḥ praveśe mahābodhisattvo 'jitañjayo nāma • ālekhyaḥ | prasannamūrtiḥ jaṭāmakuṭadhārī daṇḍakamaṇḍaluvāmakarāvasakto {V29} dakṣiṇahastena • akṣasūtraṃ gṛhītvā varadapradānakara īṣadbhrukuṭīvadano dvārābhimukha ālekhyaḥ || 2.146 ||
analyzed: ete aṣṭa uṣṇīṣa rājānaḥ pratyekabuddhānām vāmatas ālekhyāḥ dvāre ca bodhisattvau kāryau lokātikrāntagāmī nāma jaṭā makuṭa dhārī saumya mūrtiḥ dakṣiṇa hastena akṣa sūtram gṛhītvā vāma hastena kamaṇḍalum dvāra abhimukhaḥ īṣat bhrukuṭī vadanaḥ vāmatas praveśe mahā bodhisattvaḥ jitañjayaḥ nāma ālekhyaḥ prasanna mūrtiḥ jaṭā makuṭa dhārī daṇḍa kamaṇḍalu vāma kara avasaktaḥ dakṣiṇa hastena akṣa sūtram gṛhīt

original: siṃhāsanasyādhastād dharmacakraḥ samantajvālamālākulaḥ | tasyāpy adhastād ratnavimānaḥ | tatrastho bhagavān mahābodhisattvo mañjuśrīḥ kumarabhūtaḥ kumārarūpī kuṅkumagaurākāraḥ prasannamūrtiś cārurūpī īṣatprahasitavadanaḥ | vāmahaste nīlotpalāvasakto dakṣiṇahastena śrīphalāvasaktavaradaḥ || 2.147 ||
analyzed: siṃhāsanasya adhastāt dharma cakraḥ samanta jvāla mālā ākulaḥ tasya api adhastāt ratna vimānaḥ tatrasthaḥ bhagavān mahā bodhisattvaḥ mañjuśrīḥ kumara bhūtaḥ kumāra rūpī kuṅkuma gaura ākāraḥ prasanna mūrtiḥ cāru rūpī īṣat prahasita vadanaḥ vāma haste nīlotpala avasaktaḥ dakṣiṇa hastena śrīphala avasakta vara daḥ

original: sarvabālālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ pañcacīrakopaśobhito muktāvalīyajñopavītaḥ paṭṭāṃśukottarīyaḥ paṭṭavastranivastaḥ samantaprabhaḥ samantajvālamālākulaḥ | {B39v} padmāsanopaniṣaṇṇo yamāntakakrodharājatadṛṣṭir maṇḍalapraveśadvārābhimukhaś cārudarśano sarvata ālekhyaḥ || 2.148 || {S42}
analyzed: sarva bāla alaṅkāra bhūṣitaḥ pañca cīraka upaśobhitaḥ muktā āvalī yajñopavītaḥ paṭṭa aṃśuka uttarīyaḥ paṭṭa vastra nivastaḥ samanta prabhaḥ samanta jvāla mālā ākulaḥ padmāsana upaniṣaṇṇaḥ yama antaka krodha rājata dṛṣṭiḥ maṇḍala praveśa dvāra abhimukhaḥ cāru darśano sarvatas ālekhyaḥ

original: tasya dakṣiṇe pārśve padmasyādhastād yamāntakaḥ krodharāja ālekhyaḥ | mahāvikṛtarūpī samantajvālamālākulaḥ | ājñāṃ pratīcchamāno mahābodhisattvagatadṛṣṭiḥ sarvata ālekhyaḥ | vāmapārśve padmasyādhastāc chuddhāvāsakāyikā devaputrarūpiṇo bodhisattvāḥ pañca ālekhyāḥ | tadyathā sunirmalaḥ sudāntaḥ suśuddhas tamodghātanaḥ samantāvalokaś ceti | sarve ca te śuddhāvāsabhavanopaniṣaṇṇā anekaratnojjvalaśilātalākārāḥ samantajvālavicitrāḥ puṣpāvakīrṇāś cārurūpiṇa ālekhyāḥ || 2.149 ||
analyzed: tasya dakṣiṇe pārśve padmasya adhastāt yamāntakaḥ krodha rājaḥ ālekhyaḥ mahā vikṛta rūpī samanta jvāla mālā ākulaḥ ājñām pratīcchamānaḥ mahā bodhisattva gata dṛṣṭiḥ sarvatas ālekhyaḥ vāma pārśve padmasya adhastāt śuddhāvāsa kāyikāḥ devaputra rūpiṇaḥ bodhisattvāḥ pañca ālekhyāḥ tat yathā su nirmalaḥ su dāntaḥ su śuddhaḥ tama udghātanaḥ samanta avalokaḥ ca iti sarve ca te śuddhāvāsa bhavana upaniṣaṇṇāḥ aneka ratna

original: bahiḥ samantāc caturasrākāraṃ catustoraṇākāraṃ caturdiśaṃ vicitrapañcaraṅgojjvalaṃ suprabhaguṇarekhāvanaddham abhyantaramaṇḍalaṃ kāryam | pūrvāyāṃ diśi bhagavataḥ śākyamuner upariṣṭād rekhābhir madhye saṃkusumitarājendraḥ padmāsanopaniṣaṇṇas tathāgatavigrahaḥ svalpamātraḥ kāryaḥ | samantajvālamālākulo varadapradānahastaḥ paryaṅkopaniṣaṇṇaḥ || 2.150 ||
analyzed: bahis samantāt catur asra ākāram catur toraṇa ākāram caturdiśam vicitra pañca raṅga ujjvalam su prabha guṇa rekhā avanaddham abhyantara maṇḍalam kāryam pūrvāyām diśi bhagavataḥ śākyamuneḥ upariṣṭāt rekhābhiḥ madhye saṃkusumita rāja indraḥ padmāsana upaniṣaṇṇaḥ tathāgata vigrahaḥ su alpa mātraḥ kāryaḥ samanta jvāla mālā ākulaḥ vara da pradāna hastaḥ paryaṅka upaniṣaṇṇaḥ

original: tasya dakṣiṇata uṣṇīṣacakravartimudrā {B40r} lekhyā | vāmatas tejorāśimudrā lekhyā | tathāgatalocanāyā • upariṣṭāt prajñāpāramitāmudrā lekhyā | bhagavata āryāvalokiteśvarasyopariṣṭāt prajñāpāramitāmudrāyā dakṣiṇato bhagavān amitābhas tathāgatavigrahaḥ kāryo varapradānahastaḥ padmāsanopaniṣaṇṇaḥ samantajvālamālākulaḥ || 2.151 ||
analyzed: tasya dakṣiṇatas uṣṇīṣa cakravarti mudrā lekhyā vāmatas tejorāśi mudrā lekhyā tathāgata locanāyāḥ upariṣṭāt prajñāpāramitā mudrā lekhyā bhagavataḥ ārya avalokiteśvarasya upariṣṭāt prajñāpāramitā mudrāyāḥ dakṣiṇatas bhagavān amitābhaḥ tathāgata vigrahaḥ kāryaḥ vara pradāna hastaḥ padmāsana upaniṣaṇṇaḥ samanta jvāla mālā ākulaḥ

original: tasyāpi dakṣiṇataḥ pātracīvaramudre kārye | evam anupūrvataḥ praveśasthāne padmamudrā kāryā | bhagavataḥ saṃkusumitarājasya tathāgatasya vāmata uṣṇīṣatejorāśimudrā lekhyā samantajvālamālākulāḥ | tasyāpi vāmato ratnaketus tathāgataḥ kāryo ratnaparvatopaniṣaṇṇo dharmaṃ deśayamāno nīlavaiḍūryamarakatapadmarāgavicitrajvālābhivinirgataḥ samantāt samantaprabha ālekhyaḥ || 2.152 ||
analyzed: tasya api dakṣiṇatas pātra cīvara mudre kārye evam anupūrvataḥ praveśa sthāne padma mudrā kāryā bhagavataḥ saṃkusumita rājasya tathāgatasya vāmatas uṣṇīṣa tejaḥ rāśi mudrā lekhyā samanta jvāla mālā ākulāḥ tasya api vāmatas ratnaketuḥ tathāgataḥ kāryaḥ ratna parvata upaniṣaṇṇaḥ dharmam deśayamānaḥ nīla vaiḍūrya marakata padmarāga vicitra jvālā abhivinirgataḥ samantāt samanta prabhaḥ ālekhyaḥ

original: tasyāpi vāmato jayoṣṇīṣamudrā samantajvālamālākulā • ālekhyā | tasyāpi vāmato dharmacakramudrā • ālekhyā samantajvālāvatī | tasyāpi vāmataḥ khakharakakamaṇḍalu•akṣasūtrabhadrapīṭhamudrā ālekhyā | anupūrvato dvārasthāne bhūvajras trisūcyobhayataḥ samantajvāla {S43} ālekhyaḥ | bhagavato mañjuśriyasyādhastān mahāmudrā pañcaśikhā nāma • utpalamudrā ca • ālekhyā | {B40v} samantajvālinau • etau • anyonyāsaktam || 2.153 ||
analyzed: tasya api vāmatas jaya uṣṇīṣa mudrā samanta jvāla mālā ākulā ālekhyā tasya api vāmatas dharmacakra mudrā ālekhyā samanta jvālāvatī tasya api vāmatas kha kharaka kamaṇḍalu akṣasūtra bhadrapīṭha mudrā ālekhyā anupūrvatas dvāra sthāne bhū vajraḥ tri sūcyā ubhayatas samanta jvāla ālekhyaḥ bhagavataḥ mañjuśriyasya adhastāt mahāmudrā pañcaśikhā nāma utpala mudrā ca ālekhyā samanta jvālinau etau anyonya āsaktam

original: samantamaṇḍalākāram ālekhyam | dvārataḥ paścān mukhapraveśataḥ {V30} prāṅmukhaś ca kāryaḥ | sarveṣv api bahirmaṇḍalaṃ bhavati pañcavarṇaraṅgojjvalaṃ vicitracārudarśanaṃ catuṣkoṇavibhaktaṃ catustoraṇākāraṃ caturdiśaṃ dvihastamātraṃbhyantaramaṇḍalato bahir ālekhyam || 2.154 ||
analyzed: samanta maṇḍala ākāram ālekhyam dvārataḥ paścāt mukha praveśataḥ prāc mukhaḥ ca kāryaḥ sarveṣu api bahis maṇḍalam bhavati pañca varṇa raṅga ujjvalam vicitra cāru darśanam catuṣkoṇa vibhaktam catur toraṇa ākāram caturdiśam dvi hasta mātram abhyantara maṇḍalataḥ bahis ālekhyam

original: pūrvāyāṃ diśi mahābrahmā caturmukhaḥ śuklavastranivastaḥ śvetavastrottarāsaṅginaḥ śvetayajñopavītaḥ kanakavarṇo jaṭāmakuṭadhārī daṇḍakamaṇḍalur vāmāvasaktapāṇiḥ | tasya dakṣiṇata ābhāsvaro devaputraḥ kāryaḥ | kanakavarṇo dhyānāntaragatamūrtiḥ paṭṭavastranivastaḥ paṭṭāṃśukottarīyaḥ suprasannavadano jaṭāmakuṭadhārī śvetayajñopavītaḥ paryaṅkopaniṣaṇṇaḥ dakṣiṇahastena varadaḥ || 2.155 ||
analyzed: pūrvāyām diśi mahābrahmā caturmukhaḥ śukla vastra nivastaḥ śveta vastra uttarāsaṅginaḥ śveta yajñopavītaḥ kanaka varṇaḥ jaṭā makuṭa dhārī daṇḍa kamaṇḍaluḥ vāma avasakta pāṇiḥ tasya dakṣiṇatas ābhāsvaraḥ devaputraḥ kāryaḥ kanaka varṇaḥ dhyāna antara gata mūrtiḥ paṭṭa vastra nivastaḥ paṭṭāṃśuka uttarīyaḥ su prasanna vadanaḥ jaṭā makuṭa dhārī śveta yajñopavītaḥ paryaṅka upaniṣaṇṇaḥ dakṣiṇa hastena

original: tasya dakṣiṇata akaniṣṭho devaputraḥ kāryaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ prasannamūrtir dhyānagatacetasaḥ paṭṭavastranivasananivastaḥ paṭṭāṃśukottarīyaḥ paryaṅkopaviṣṭaḥ dakṣiṇahastena varadaḥ śvetayajñopavītaḥ | evam anupūrvataḥ santuṣitaḥ sunirmitaḥ paranirmitaḥ suyāmaśakraprabhṛtayo devaputrā ālekhyā {B41r} yathānupūrvato yathāvasthānāḥ | śakrasyādhastāc cāturmahārājakāyikāḥ sadāmattā mālādhāriṇaḥ karoṭapāṇayo vīṇādvitīyakā lekhyāḥ | bhaumāś ca devaputrā yathānupūrvato yathāveṣenālekhyāḥ || 2.156 ||
analyzed: tasya dakṣiṇatas akaniṣṭhaḥ deva putraḥ kāryaḥ sarva alaṅkāra bhūṣitaḥ prasanna mūrtiḥ dhyāna gata cetasaḥ paṭṭa vastra nivasana nivastaḥ paṭṭa aṃśuka uttarīyaḥ paryaṅka upaviṣṭaḥ dakṣiṇa hastena vara daḥ śveta yajñopavītaḥ evam anupūrvatas san tuṣitaḥ sunirmitaḥ para nirmitaḥ suyāma śakra prabhṛtayaḥ deva putrāḥ ālekhyāḥ yathā anupūrvatas yathā avasthānāḥ śakrasya adhastāt cāturmahārājakāyikāḥ sadāmattā

original: evaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi avṛha•atapāsudṛśasudarśanaparīttābhapuṇyaprasavaprabhṛtayo devaputrā ālekhyā yathāveṣasthānāḥ | evaṃ paścimāyāṃ diśi evaṃ cottarāyāṃ diśi | teṣām adhastād dvipaṅktyāśritā ālekhyāḥ || 2.157 ||
analyzed: evam dakṣiṇāyām diśi avṛha atapa sudṛśa sudarśana parīttābha puṇyaprasava prabhṛtayaḥ devaputrāḥ ālekhyāḥ yathā veṣa sthānāḥ evam paścimāyām diśi evam ca uttarāyām diśi teṣām adhastāt dvi paṅkti āśritāḥ ālekhyāḥ

original: dvitīyamaṇḍalād bahis tṛtīyamaṇḍalaṃ bhavati | caturdiśaṃ catvāro mahārājānaḥ anupūrvata ālekhyāḥ | uttarāyāṃ diśi praveṣato dakṣiṇato dhanado nidhisamīpasthaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣita īṣadbhagnakirīṭo yakṣarūpī | tasya dakṣiṇato maṇibhadrapūrṇabhadrau yakṣasenāpatī ālekhyau || 2.158 || {S44}
analyzed: dvitīya maṇḍalāt bahis tṛtīya maṇḍalam bhavati caturdiśam catvāraḥ mahārājānaḥ anupūrvatas ālekhyāḥ uttarāyām diśi praveṣataḥ dakṣiṇatas dhanadaḥ nidhi samīpa sthaḥ sarva alaṅkāra bhūṣitaḥ īṣat bhagna kirīṭaḥ yakṣa rūpī tasya dakṣiṇatas maṇibhadra pūrṇabhadrau yakṣa senāpatī ālekhyau

original: evam anupūrvataḥ hārītī mahāyakṣiṇī • ālekhyā | priyaṅkaraḥ kumāra utsaṅgopaviṣṭo maṇḍalaṃ nirīkṣamāṇa ālekhyaḥ | pañcikaḥ piṅgalaḥ vibhīṣaṇaś ca ālekhyaḥ | teṣāṃ ca samīpe yakṣāṇāṃ mudrā ālekhyāḥ || 2.159 ||
analyzed: evam anupūrvatas hārītī mahā yakṣiṇī ālekhyā priyaṅkaraḥ kumāraḥ utsaṅga upaviṣṭaḥ maṇḍalam nirīkṣamāṇaḥ ālekhyaḥ pañcikaḥ piṅgalaḥ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ca ālekhyaḥ teṣām ca samīpe yakṣāṇām mudrāḥ ālekhyāḥ

original: evam anupūrvato varuṇaḥ pāśahastaḥ paścimāyāṃ {B41v} diśi ālekhyaḥ | nāgau nandopanandau takṣakavāsukiprabhṛtayo 'ṣṭau mahānāgarājāna ālekhyāḥ || 2.160 ||
analyzed: evam anupūrvatas varuṇaḥ pāśa hastaḥ paścimāyām diśi ālekhyaḥ nāgau nanda upanandau takṣaka vāsuki prabhṛtayaḥ ṣṭau mahā nāga rājānaḥ ālekhyāḥ
dvi paṅkti āśritāḥ

original: yakṣarākṣasagandharvakiṃnaramahoragaṛṣayaḥ siddhapretapiśācagaruḍakinnaramanuṣyāmanuṣyādyā oṣadhayaś ca maṇiratnaviśeṣāḥ parvatāḥ sarito dvīpāś ca • anupūrvataḥ sarve pradhānākhyā mukhyatamāś cābhilekhyāḥ || 2.161 ||
analyzed: yakṣa rākṣasa gandharva kiṃnara mahoraga ṛṣayaḥ siddha preta piśāca garuḍa kinnara manuṣya amanuṣya ādyāḥ oṣadhayaḥ ca maṇi ratna viśeṣāḥ parvatāḥ saritaḥ dvīpāḥ ca anupūrvataḥ sarve pradhāna ākhyāḥ mukhyatamāḥ ca abhilekhyāḥ

original: dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi yama ālekhyaḥ saparivāro mātarāḥ sapta | pūrvadakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi • agniḥ samantajvālamālākulo
analyzed: dakṣiṇāyām diśi yamaḥ ālekhyaḥ sa parivāraḥ mātarāḥ sapta pūrvadakṣiṇāyām diśi agniḥ samanta jvāla mālā ākulaḥ
daṇḍa kamaṇḍalu akṣasūtra vyagra pāṇiḥ
śveta vastra nivastaḥ paṭṭa aṃśuka uttarāsaṅgikaḥ

original: kanakavarṇo bhasmatripuṇḍrīkṛtaḥ | nānābharaṇapraharaṇaveṣasaṃsthānavarṇataś ca dvipaṅktyāśritā ālekhyāḥ || 2.162 ||
analyzed: kanaka varṇaḥ bhasma tripuṇḍrīkṛtaḥ nānā ābharaṇa praharaṇa veṣa saṃsthāna varṇataḥ ca dvi paṅkti āśritāḥ ālekhyāḥ

original: sarvataḥ praviśato bahirmaṇḍale umāpatir vṛṣavāhanas triśūlapāṇir umā ca devī kanakavarṇā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā | kārttikeyaś ca mayūrāsanaḥ śaktyudyatahastaḥ kumārarūpī ṣaṇmukhaḥ raktābhāsamūrtiḥ pītavastranivastaḥ pītavastrottarāsaṅgo vāmahastena {B42r} ghaṇṭāṃ gṛhītvā raktapatākāṃ ca | anupūrvato bhṛṅgiriṭir atyantakṛśākāro mahāgaṇapatiś ca nandikeśvaramahākālau mātarāḥ sapta yathābharaṇapraharaṇaveṣasaṃsthānābhilekhyāḥ || 2.163 ||
analyzed: sarvatas praviśataḥ bahis maṇḍale umāpatiḥ vṛṣavāhanaḥ triśūla pāṇiḥ umā ca devī kanaka varṇā sarva alaṅkāra bhūṣitā kārttikeyaḥ ca mayūrāsanaḥ śakti udyata hastaḥ kumāra rūpī ṣaṇmukhaḥ rakta ābhāsa mūrtiḥ pīta vastra uttarāsaṅgaḥ vāma hastena ghaṇṭām gṛhītvā rakta patākām ca anupūrvatas bhṛṅgiriṭiḥ atyanta kṛśa ākāraḥ mahāgaṇapatiḥ ca nandikeśvara mahākālau mātarāḥ sapta yathā ābharaṇa praharaṇa

original: aṣṭau vasavaḥ saptarṣayo viṣṇuś cakrapāṇiś caturbhujo gadāśaṅkhāsihasto garuḍāsanaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaś ca | aṣṭau grahāḥ saptaviṃśatinakṣatrā ye pracaranti bhuvi maṇḍale • upagrahāś cāṣṭā devā lekhyāḥ | anupūrvataḥ pañcadaśa tithayaḥ sitakṛṣṇā dvādaśa rāśayo ṣaḍ ṛtavo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraś ca | caturbhaginyaḥ
analyzed: aṣṭau vasavaḥ saptarṣayaḥ viṣṇuḥ cakrapāṇiḥ caturbhujaḥ gadā śaṅkha asi hastaḥ garuḍāsanaḥ sarva alaṅkāra bhūṣitaḥ ca aṣṭau grahāḥ saptaviṃśati nakṣatrāḥ ye pracaranti bhuvi maṇḍale upagrahāḥ ca aṣṭā devāḥ lekhyāḥ anupūrvataḥ pañcadaśa tithayaḥ sita kṛṣṇāḥ dvādaśa rāśayaḥ ṣaṭ ṛtavaḥ dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ ca catur bhaginyaḥ
jaṭā makuṭa dhārī śveta yajñopavītaḥ

original: nāvābhirūḍhāḥ bhrātṛpañcamāḥ salilavāsinaś ceti | saṃkṣepato mudrāsu vyavasthāpyā hi devatā | anupūrvataś ca dvipaṅktyāśritāś ca kāryāḥ || 2.164 ||
analyzed: nāvā abhirūḍhāḥ bhrātṛ pañcamāḥ salila vāsinaḥ ca iti saṃkṣepataḥ mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ hi devatāḥ anupūrvataḥ ca dvi paṅkti āśritāḥ ca kāryāḥ

original: saṃkṣepato maṇḍalatraye 'pi trimaṇḍalāśrayo 'bhilekhyaḥ | caturasraś ca trimaṇḍaleṣv api vyavasthā saiṣā bhavati || 2.165 ||
analyzed: saṃkṣepataḥ maṇḍala traye tri maṇḍala āśrayaḥ bhilekhyaḥ catur asraḥ ca tri maṇḍaleṣu api vyavasthā sā eṣā bhavati

original: saṃkṣepato buddho bhagavān {S45} sarvasattvānām agro 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | {B42v} abjakule āryāvalokiteśvaro dakṣiṇato 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | vāmato vajrakule āryavajrapāṇir avaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | bodhisattvānām agra āryasamantabhadro 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | mañjuśrīḥ kumarabhūto 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | śaiṣā mudrāsu yathāvyavasthāyām abhilekhyāḥ | etad abhyantaramaṇḍalam || 2.166 ||
analyzed: saṃkṣepataḥ buddhaḥ bhagavān SNM sarva sattvānām agraḥ vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ abja kule ārya avalokiteśvaraḥ dakṣiṇatas vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ vāmatas vajra kule ārya vajrapāṇiḥ avaśyam abhilekhyaḥ bodhisattvānām agre ārya samantabhadraḥ vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ mañjuśrīḥ kumara bhūtaḥ vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ śaiṣāḥ mudrāsu yathā vyavasthāyām abhilekhyāḥ etat abhyantara maṇḍalam

original: madhyamaṇḍale 'pi brahmā sahāmpatiḥ pūrvāyāṃ diśy avaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | evam ābhāsvaro dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśy akaniṣṭho rūpinaś ca devā maṇḍalākārā•avyaktā naivasaṃjñānāsaṃjñāyatanā devāḥ | uttarāyāṃ diśi śakro devarājā suyāmaḥ saṃtuṣitaḥ sunirmitaḥ paranirmitaḥ parīttābhaprabhṛtayo devaputrā avaśyam ekaikaḥ devarājo 'bhilikhitavyaḥ | śaiṣā mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ || 2.167 ||
analyzed: madhya maṇḍale pi brahmā sahāmpatiḥ pūrvāyām diśi avaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ evam ābhāsvaraḥ dakṣiṇāyām diśi akaniṣṭhaḥ rūpinaḥ ca devāḥ maṇḍala ākārāḥ avyaktāḥ na eva saṃjñā na asaṃjñā āyatanāḥ devāḥ uttarāyām diśi śakraḥ devarājā suyāmaḥ saṃtuṣitaḥ sunirmitaḥ paranirmitaḥ parīttābha prabhṛtayaḥ devaputrāḥ avaśyam ekaikaḥ devarājaḥ abhilikhitavyaḥ śaiṣāḥ mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ

original: evaṃ tṛtīyamaṇḍale 'py uttarāyāṃ diśi • īśāno bhūtādhipatiḥ sahomayāvaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | dvitīyadvārasamīpe kārttikeyamañjuśrīr mayūrāsanaḥ śaktipāṇiḥ raktāvabhāsamūrtiḥ pītavastranivastottarāsaṅgino dakṣiṇahaste ghaṇṭāraktapatākāvasaktaḥ kumārarūpī maṇḍalaṃ nirīkṣamāṇaḥ | pūrvāyāṃ diśi vainateyaḥ {B43r} pakṣirūpī | ṛṣir mārkaṇḍo 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | śaiṣā mudrāsu ca vyavasthāpyāḥ || 2.168 ||
analyzed: evam tṛtīya maṇḍale pi uttarāyām diśi īśānaḥ bhūta adhipatiḥ saha umayā avaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ dvitīya dvāra samīpe kārttikeya mañjuśrīḥ mayūrāsanaḥ śaktipāṇiḥ rakta avabhāsa mūrtiḥ dakṣiṇa haste ghaṇṭā rakta patākā avasaktaḥ kumāra rūpī maṇḍalam nirīkṣamāṇaḥ pūrvāyām diśi vainateyaḥ pakṣi rūpī ṛṣiḥ mārkaṇḍaḥ vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ śaiṣāḥ mudrāsu ca vyavasthāpyāḥ

original: dakṣiṇapūrvataś catuḥkumāryaḥ kumārabhrātṛsahitā nauyānasaṃsthitā mahodadheḥ paribhramantyaḥ | agniś ca devarāṭ avaśyaṃ likhitavyaḥ | evaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi laṅkāpurī vibhīṣaṇaś ca rākṣasādhipatiḥ | tatrasthitaḥ picumardavṛkṣāśrito jambhalajalendranāmā yakṣarūpī bodhisattvo 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | evam anupūrvato yamo rājā pretamaharddhiko 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | evaṃ piśācarājā vikarālo nāmāvaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | śaiṣā mudrāsu vyavasthāpyā || 2.169 ||
analyzed: dakṣiṇa pūrvatas catur kumāryaḥ kumāra bhrātṛ sahitāḥ nau yāna saṃsthitāḥ mahā udadheḥ paribhramantyaḥ agniḥ ca deva rāj avaśyam likhitavyaḥ evam dakṣiṇāyām diśi laṅkā purī vibhīṣaṇaḥ ca rākṣasa adhipatiḥ tatrasthitaḥ picumarda vṛkṣa āśritaḥ jambhala jalendra nāmā yakṣa rūpī bodhisattvaḥ vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ evam anupūrvataḥ yamaḥ rājā preta maharddhikaḥ vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ evam piśāca rājā vikarālaḥ nāma av

original: evaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ diśi nandopanandau nāgamukhyau • avaśyam abhilikhitavyau grahamukhyaś cādityaḥ | paścimāyāṃ diśi kapilamunir nāma • ṛṣivaro nirgranthatīrthaṃkaraṛṣabho {V32} nirgrantharūpī | anupūrvataḥ śaiṣā mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ || 2.170 ||
analyzed: evam dakṣiṇa paścimāyām diśi nanda upanandau nāga mukhyau avaśyam abhilikhitavyau graha mukhyaḥ ca ādityaḥ paścimāyām diśi kapilamuniḥ nāma ṛṣi varaḥ nirgrantha tīrthaṃkara ṛṣabhaḥ nirgrantha rūpī anupūrvataḥ śaiṣāḥ mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ

original: uttarapaścimāsu ca diśāsu {B43v} yakṣarāḍ dhanado {S46} gandharvarāṭ pañcaśikhaḥ kiṃnararājā drumaḥ | ete 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyāḥ | śaiṣā mudrāsu ca • anupūrvato yathāsthānaṃ saṃsthitā abhilikhitavyā iti || 2.171 ||
analyzed: uttara paścimāsu ca diśāsu yakṣarāj dhanadaḥ gandharvarāj pañcaśikhaḥ kiṃnararājā drumaḥ ete vaśyam abhilikhitavyāḥ śaiṣāḥ mudrāsu ca anupūrvataḥ yathāsthānam saṃsthitāḥ abhilikhitavyāḥ iti

original: caturthamaṇḍalaṃ bahiḥ pañcarekhācitaṃ mudrāmālābhiś copaśobhitaṃ caturasraṃ catustoraṇākāraṃ caturmahārājavibhūṣitam | yathānupūrvasthitās tadyathā mudrā bhavanti || 2.172 ||
analyzed: caturtha maṇḍalam bahis pañca rekhā citam mudrā mālābhiḥ ca upaśobhitam catur asram catur toraṇa ākāram catur mahārāja vibhūṣitam yathā anupūrva sthitāḥ tat yathā mudrāḥ bhavanti

original: dvārapradeśe nīlotpalam abhilekhyam | dakṣiṇato vāmataḥ padmaṃ vajraṃ paraśukhaḍgatriśūlagadācakrasvastikakalaśamīnaśaṅkhakuṇḍaladhvajapatākapāśaghaṇṭākaṭṭārakadhanurnārācamudgaraḥ | etair vividhākārapraharaṇamudraiḥ samantāc caturasramālākulaṃ kuryāt | ityato bahiś caturdiśaṃ catvāro mahāsamudrāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ || 2.173 ||
analyzed: dvāra pradeśe nīlotpalam abhilekhyam dakṣiṇatas vāmatas padmam vajram paraśu khaḍga triśūla gadā cakra svastika kalaśa mīna śaṅkha kuṇḍala dhvaja patāka pāśa ghaṇṭā kaṭṭāraka dhanuḥ nārāca mudgaraḥ etaiḥ vividha ākāra praharaṇa mudraiḥ samantāt caturasra mālā ākulam kuryāt iti atas bahis caturdiśam catvāraḥ mahā samudrāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ

original: uttarāyāṃ diśi caturasrākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā ubhayavajraṃ trisūcyākāraṃ samantajvālam | pūrvāyāṃ diśi padmaṃ samantajvālaṃ trikoṇākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayet | {B44r} dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi dhanvākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ samantajvālaṃ sthāpayet | paścimāyāṃ diśi samantaprabhākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā nīlotpalaṃ sanālapattropetaṃ samantajvālam || 2.174 ||
analyzed: uttarāyām diśi catur asra ākāram maṇḍalakam kṛtvā ubhaya vajram tri sūci ākāram samanta jvālam pūrvāyām diśi padmam samanta jvālam trikoṇa ākāram maṇḍalakam kṛtvā sthāpayet dakṣiṇāyām diśi dhanva ākāram maṇḍalakam kṛtvā pātram samanta jvālam sthāpayet paścimāyām diśi samantaprabhā ākāram maṇḍalakam kṛtvā nīlotpalam sa nāla pattra upetam samanta jvālam

original: vidikṣu ca catvāro mudrā bhavanti | uttarapaścimāyāṃ diśi pāśaṃ vartulākāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā samantajvālam | dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ diśi dīrghākāramaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍaṃ samantajvālam | dakṣiṇapūrvāyāṃ diśi paraśuṃ samantajvālaṃ trikoṇākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā | pūrvottarāyāṃ diśi khaḍgaṃ samantajvālaṃ sthāpayet || 2.175 ||
analyzed: vidikṣu ca catvāraḥ mudrāḥ bhavanti uttara paścimāyām diśi pāśam vartula ākāram maṇḍalam kṛtvā samanta jvālam dakṣiṇa paścimāyām diśi dīrgha ākāra maṇḍalakam kṛtvā daṇḍam samanta jvālam dakṣiṇa pūrvāyām diśi paraśum samanta jvālam trikoṇa ākāram maṇḍalakam kṛtvā pūrva uttarāyām diśi khaḍgam samanta jvālam sthāpayet

original: ālikhya sarvata ity ūrdhvam adhas tiryak trīṇi mudrā dvārasamīpe bahir maṇḍalasyālekhyāś cūrṇair eva | tadyathā vastraṃ vyajanam upānahau ca samantajvālinas tv ete • abhilekhyā iti || 2.176 ||
analyzed: ālikhya sarvatas iti ūrdhvam adhas tiryak trīṇi mudrāḥ dvāra samīpe bahis maṇḍalasya ālekhyāḥ cūrṇaiḥ eva tat yathā vastram vyajanam upānahau ca samanta jvālinaḥ tu ete abhilekhyāḥ iti

original: etan maṇḍalavidhānaṃ kathitaṃ tv iha samāsataḥ |

original: {V232} atha vajraṃ sādhayitukāmo valmīkamiśrayā mṛttikayā vālukamiśrayā vajraṃ kṛtvā bhikṣāhāro maunī • apatthadāyī vajraṃ gṛhya trīṇi {S298} lakṣa japet | ekasūcikaṃ vajraṃ kartavyam | taṃ vajram ante siddhārthakamadhye sthāpya candragrahe candragrahe sthātavyam | tāvaj japed yāvat sarṣapā ciṭiciṭāyanti | vajraṃ siddhaṃ bhavati | tena vajreṇa gṛhītena sarvakarmāṇi karoti | parvataśikharāṇi cūrṇayati | nāgahradaṃ śoṣayati | nadīḥ pratisrotam ānayati | nāgān vidrāpayati | viṣāṇi nirviṣīkaroti | sarve prāṇinaḥ stambhayati | mohayati | pātayati | yantrāṇi cūrṇayati | śakaṭaprabhṛtīni ca stambhayati | cūrṇayati | evam ādīni sarvakarmāṇi karoti | eṣa ekasūcikasya vajrasya sādhanam || 26.49 ||

original: uṣṇīṣacakravartinaṃ sādhayato na kaścic chaknoti vighnaṃ kartum | sākṣān mūrdhnaṭako 'pi hi vidhinā nāvidhinā | asya ca jāpakāle satataṃ buddhalocanāṃ pūrvaṃ paścāc ca japtavyam | evaṃ saumyatvaṃ bhavati | siddhir asyābhimukhībhavati || 26.50 ||
analyzed: uṣṇīṣa cakravartinam sādhayataḥ na kaścid śaknoti vighnam kartum sākṣāt hi vidhinā na a vidhinā asya ca jāpa kāle satatam buddha locanām pūrvam paścāt ca japtavyam evam saumya tvam bhavati siddhiḥ asya abhimukhībhavati

original: atha samudrāgāminīṃ nadīm avatīrya padmānāṃ lakṣa nivedayet | śrī • āgatya varaṃ prayacchati | rāṣṭraṃ dadāti | atha trīṇi lakṣāṇi nivedayet | sārvabhaumiko rājā bhavati | jambūdvīpādhipatir bhavati | vivarasyāgrataḥ paṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya lakṣāṇi trīṇi japet | sarvayantrāṇi patanti | nirviśaṅkena praveṣṭavyam | praviśya rasarasāyanaṃ niḥkāśayati | atha tatraiva tiṣṭhati | vaiṣṇavacakrabhayam utpadyate | atha praviśati anusmaritamātreṇa bhasmībhavati | manasena utthāpayati | na kadācid api praviśati tasmiṃ || 26.51 ||
analyzed: atha samudrāgāminīm nadīm avatīrya padmānām nivedayet śrīḥ āgatya varam prayacchati rāṣṭram dadāti atha trīṇi lakṣāṇi nivedayet sārvabhaumikaḥ rājā bhavati jambūdvīpa adhipatiḥ bhavati vivarasya agratas paṭam pratiṣṭhāpya lakṣāṇi trīṇi japet sarva yantrāṇi patanti nirviśaṅkena praveṣṭavyam praviśya rasa rasāyanam niḥkāśayati atha tatra eva tiṣṭhati vaiṣṇava cakra bhayam utpadyate atha praviśati anusmarita mātreṇa bhasmībhūta iti

original: śuklapratipadam ārabhya triḥkālaṃ jātīkusumaiḥ sakṛjjaptena bhagavatā pādāṅguṣṭhe tāḍayitavyaṃ yāvat pādāṅguṣṭhād raśmir niścarati sādhakaśarīre 'ntardhīyati | tatkṣaṇād evākuñcitakuṇḍalakeśo bhavati | saparivāra utpatati | vidyādhararājā bhavati kalpasthāyī || 26.52 ||
analyzed: śukla pratipadam ārabhya triḥkālam jātī kusumaiḥ sakṛt japtena bhagavatā pādāṅguṣṭhe tāḍayitavyam yāvat pādāṅguṣṭhāt raśmiḥ niścarati sādhaka śarīre ntardhīyati tad kṣaṇāt eva ākuñcita kuṇḍala keśaḥ bhavati sa parivāraḥ utpatati vidyādhara rājā bhavati kalpa sthāyī

original: atha samudrataṭe paścānmukhaṃ paṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nāgakāṣṭhair agniṃ prajvālya samudrasya • uddiśya nāgapuṣpāṇāṃ lakṣaṃ juhuyāt | samudre • ūrmaya āgacchanti | siddhinimittaṃ na bhetavyam | tāvad yāvat samudro brāhmaṇaveṣeṇāgacchati | bravīti kiṃ mayā kartavyam | vaktavyam | vaśyo me bhava | tato yad ucyate tat sarvaṃ karoti || 26.53 || {S299}
analyzed: atha samudra taṭe paścānmukham paṭam pratiṣṭhāpya nāga kāṣṭhaiḥ agnim prajvālya samudrasya uddiśya nāga puṣpāṇām lakṣam juhuyāt samudre ūrmayaḥ āgacchanti siddhi nimittam na bhetavyam tāvat yāvat samudraḥ brāhmaṇa veṣeṇa āgacchati bravīti kim mayā kartavyam vaktavyam vaśyaḥ me bhava tatas yat ucyate tat sarvam karoti

original: padmaṃ bhūmyāṃ likhya sahasrapatraṃ tasyopary upaviśya śatasahasraṃ japet | bhūmiṃ bhittvā • uttiṣṭhati | sahasraparivāra utpatati | mahākalpasthāyī vidyādhararājā bhavati | aparipatthadāyī tejena pañca yojanāni avabhāsayati || 26.54 ||
analyzed: padmam bhūmyām likhya sahasra patram tasya upari upaviśya śata sahasram japet bhūmim bhittvā uttiṣṭhati sahasra parivāraḥ utpatati mahākalpa sthāyī vidyādhara rājā bhavati a paripattha dāyī tejena pañca yojanāni avabhāsayati

original: prātihārakapakṣe jātīpuṣpāṇāṃ bhagavataḥ • uṣṇīṣarājasyopari lakṣaṃ nivedayet | ekaikaṃ japtavyam | tāvad yāvad uṣṇīṣād raśmir niścarati | sādhakasya śarīre 'ntardhīyate | tatkṣaṇād eva pañcābhijño bhavati | daśalakṣajapto yathā yathā prayujyati tathā tathā anenaiva bhagavatā sārdhaṃ yadi vidyā japyate sā niyatam āgacchati sākṣād asya japyamānā | yadi na vāgacchati sa mūrdhnā sphuṭati | śuṣyati || 26.55 || {V233}
analyzed: prātihāraka pakṣe jātī puṣpāṇām bhagavataḥ uṣṇīṣa rājasya upari lakṣam nivedayet ekaikam japtavyam tāvat yāvat uṣṇīṣāt raśmiḥ niścarati sādhakasya śarīre ntardhīyate tad kṣaṇāt eva pañca abhijñaḥ bhavati daśa lakṣa japtaḥ yathā yathā prayujyati tathā tathā anena eva bhagavatā sārdham yadi vidyā japyate sā niyatam āgacchati sākṣāt asya japyamānā yadi na vā āgacchati sa mūrdhnā sphuṭati śuṣyati

original: ayaṃ ca • ekākṣara uṣṇīṣacakravartī tathāgata eva sākṣāt | ko 'nyaḥ sadevake loke sarvamantravidyānāṃ rājā tathāgata eva | sitātapatratejorāśipramukhāni • asya parivāraḥ | sarveṣām uṣṇīṣarājānāṃ sādhanavidhāna sarvam atraiva yojyam | sarve ca • uṣṇīṣarājā • anena sādhyāḥ | uttamasādhanam icchatā • asthāne na yojyam | yadi yujyati • uttamā siddhir na bhavati | saṃkṣepataḥ sarve devā anenākṛṣyante || 26.56 ||
analyzed: ayam ca ekākṣaraḥ uṣṇīṣa cakravartī tathāgataḥ eva sākṣāt kaḥ nyaḥ sa devake loke sarva mantra vidyānām rājā tathāgataḥ eva sita ātapatra tejaḥ rāśi pramukhāni asya parivāraḥ sarveṣām uṣṇīṣa rājānām sādhana vidhāna sarvam atra eva yojyam sarve ca uṣṇīṣa rājāḥ anena sādhyāḥ uttama sādhanam icchatā asthāne na yojyam yadi uttamā siddhiḥ na bhavati saṃkṣepataḥ sarve devāḥ anena ākṛṣyante

original: atha nidhānam udghāṭayati | yatra nidhānaṃ tiṣṭhati tatra gatvā • akālakalaśaṃ gṛhya sarvagandhair lipya śvetacandanodakaṃ kumbhe prakṣipya • aṣṭasahasrābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā nidhānaṃ sthāpayet | yadi nidhānaṃ tiṣṭhati tadā sa bhūmiḥ sphuṭati | yadi nidhānaṃ puruṣamātre tiṣṭhati • udakena spraṣṭavyam | hastamātraṃ khatvā grahetavyaḥ || 26.57 ||
analyzed: atha nidhānam udghāṭayati yatra nidhānam tiṣṭhati tatra gatvā akāla kalaśam gṛhya sarva gandhaiḥ lipya śveta candana udakam kumbhe prakṣipya aṣṭa sahasra abhimantritam kṛtvā nidhānam sthāpayet yadi nidhānam tiṣṭhati tadā sa bhūmiḥ sphuṭati yadi nidhānam puruṣa mātre tiṣṭhati udakena spraṣṭavyam hasta mātram kha tvā grahetavyaḥ

original: atha siṃhaṃ sādhayitukāmo valmīkamṛttikayā kṛtvā gorocanayā samālabhya piṇḍikāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya • udārāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tāvaj japed yāvac calati | calitena siddho bhavati | pṛṣṭham āruhya • ākuñcitakuṇḍalakeśaḥ • ātmapañcamotpatati | brahmāyuṣo navavarṣasahasrāṇi jīvati sarvavidyādharāṇām agamyaḥ | evaṃ hastyaśvamahiṣaś ca sādhayitavyāḥ | yadā siṃhanādaṃ nadati tadā devā āsanebhyaś calanti || 26.58 || {S300}
analyzed: atha siṃham sādhayitu kāmaḥ valmīka mṛttikayā kṛtvā gorocanayā samālabhya piṇḍikāyām pratiṣṭhāpya udārām pūjām kṛtvā tāvat japet yāvat calati calitena siddhaḥ bhavati pṛṣṭham āruhya ākuñcita kuṇḍala keśaḥ ātma pañcama utpatati brahma āyuṣaḥ nava varṣa sahasrāṇi jīvati sarva vidyādharāṇām agamyaḥ evam hasti aśva mahiṣaḥ ca sādhayitavyāḥ yadā siṃhanādam nadati tadā devāḥ āsanebhyaḥ calanti

original: padmasaraṃ gatvā padmānāṃ lakṣaṃ nivedayet | sāmantarājyaṃ pratilabhate | raktakaravīrakalikānāṃ lakṣaṃ juhuyāt | rājakanyāṃ labhate | jātīpuṣpāṇāṃ lakṣaṃ samudrāgāminyāṃ nadyāṃ pravāhayet | kanyāṃ labhate yām icchati | sarve te • uttamasādhanāni siddhyanti || 26.59 ||
analyzed: padma saram gatvā padmānām lakṣam nivedayet sāmanta rājyam pratilabhate rakta karavīra kalikānām lakṣam juhuyāt rāja kanyām labhate jātī puṣpāṇām lakṣam samudra āgāminyām nadyām pravāhayet kanyām labhate yām icchati sarve te uttama sādhanāni siddhyanti

original: anenoṣṇīṣacakravartinā sa yatra gacchati indro 'py asyāsanaṃ dadāti | sarve ca devarājāno dūrād eva dṛṣṭvā bhītā trastā bhavanti | sarveṣāṃ ca devarājānāṃ prabhāṃ prabhāṃ vyāmīkaroti yojanaśatābhyantareṇa karoti || 26.60 ||

original: atha rājānaṃ vaśīkartukāmas tasya pādapāṃsuṃ gṛhītvā sarṣapais tailaiś ca miśrayitvā juhuyāt saptāhaṃ trisandhyam | vaśyo bhavati | rājñīṃ vaśīkartukāmaḥ sauvarcalāṃ śatapuṣpāṃ vārāhīṃ caikataḥ kṛtvā juhuyāt saptarātraṃ trisandhyam | vaśyā bhavati | rājāmātyaṃ vaśīkartukāmo bhallātakānāṃ tilāṃ vacāṃ ca pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā juhuyāt | saptāhaṃ saptarātraṃ ca vaśyo bhavati | {S315} purohitaṃ vaśīkartukāmo brahmadaṇḍīṃ śatapuṣpāṃ caikataḥ kṛtvā juhuyāt saptarātraṃ trisandhyam | vaśyo bhavati || 28.21 ||

original: brāhmaṇānāṃ vaśīkartukāmaḥ pāyasaṃ ghṛtasahitaṃ juhuyāt | sarve vaśyā bhavanti | atha kṣatriyaṃ vaśīkartukāmaḥ śālyodanaṃ ghṛtasahitaṃ juhuyāt saptāham | vaiśyānāṃ vaśīkaraṇe yāvakān guḍasahitān juhuyāt | vaśyo bhavati | piṇyākaṃ juhuyāt | śūdrā vaśyā bhavanti | sarvān ekataḥ kṛtvā juhuyāt sarve vaśyā bhavanti || 28.22 ||

original: sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vā kumāraṃ kṛtvā varadaṃ dakṣiṇena pāṇinā vāmena bhagavatīṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ dadhānam | tam īdṛśaṃ sadhātukakaraṇḍakaṃ purataḥ sthāpyākṣaralakṣaṃ japet | pūjāṃ vāsariṇāṃ kuryāt | bāladārakadārikāś {S317} cāsyāgrato bhojayitavyā | gītaṃ vāditaṃ pustakavācanaṃ ca kuryāt | japaparisamāptau puṣpatrayeṇārghaṃ dattvā preṣayet | pūrvoktena vidhānenāvāhanavisarjanam || 28.29 ||

original: anāhate paṭe keśāpagate • upoṣadhikena citrakareṇa aśleṣakair varṇakair āryamañjuśriyaś citrāpayitavyaḥ | padmāsanopaviṣṭaṃ dharmaṃ deśayamānam | dakṣiṇapārśve • āryamahāmekhalā vāmapārśve cāryaprajñāpāramitā jāpavatī sarvālaṅkāravibhūṣitā śuklavastranivasanā | tasyādhastāt padmasaro bahuvidhapuṣpasaṅkīrṇaḥ | nāgarājānau • akāyavinirgatau padmadaṇḍadhṛtahastau || 28.36 ||
analyzed: anāhate paṭe keśa apagate upoṣadhikena citrakareṇa aśleṣakaiḥ varṇakaiḥ ārya mañjuśriyaḥ citrāpayitavyaḥ padmāsana upaviṣṭam dharmam deśayamānam dakṣiṇa pārśve ārya mahāmekhalā vāma pārśve ca ārya prajñāpāramitā jāpavatī sarva alaṅkāra vibhūṣitā śukla vastra nivasanā tasya adhastāt padma saraḥ bahuvidha puṣpa saṅkīrṇaḥ nāga rājānau akāya vinirgatau padma daṇḍa dhṛta hastau

original: āryāparājitā caikasmiṃ vighnavināyakān nāśayantī • agnijvālāmukhī bhṛkuṭīkṛtalocanām anyasmin pārśve • āryaparṇaśavarī pāśaparaśuvyagrahastā kṛṣṇaraktanetrā mayūrapṛṣṭhabhirūḍhā sādhakaṃ parirakṣantī | sādhakaś ca padmamālāvyagrahasto bhagavato mañjuśriyamukhaṃ vyavalokayamānaḥ | upariṣṭāc cāmarapuṣpamālādundubhidhāriṇau devaputrau lekhayitavyau || 28.37 ||
analyzed: ārya aparājitā ca ekasmin vighna vināyakān nāśayantī agni jvālā mukhī bhṛkuṭī kṛta locanām anyasmin pārśve ārya parṇa śavarī pāśa paraśu vyagra hastā kṛṣṇa rakta netrā mayūra pṛṣṭha abhirūḍhā sādhakam parirakṣantī sādhakaḥ ca padma mālā vyagra hastaḥ bhagavataḥ mañjuśriya mukham vyavalokayamānaḥ upariṣṭāt cāmara puṣpa mālā dundubhi dhāriṇau devaputrau lekhayitavyau 2837

original: tasyaiva paṭasyāgrataḥ kapilāyāḥ samānavatsāyāḥ goghṛtaṃ gṛhya tāmrabhājane sthāpya tāvaj japed yāvad ūṣmāyati | dhūmāyati | prajvalati | ūṣmāyamānaṃ pītvā paramamedhāvī bhavati śrutidharaḥ | dhūmāyamāne 'ntardhānam | jvalamāne • ākāśagamanam | āmaśarāvasampuṭe sthāpya {S319} vacāṃ jātīkusumair veṣṭayitvā tāvaj japed yāvad aṅkurībhavati | tāṃ bhakṣayitvā śrutidharo bhavati | anyāṃ koṭiṃ japet mañjuśriyaṃ sākṣāt paśyati dharmadeśanāṃ ca śṛṇoti | tāñ cādhimucyate || 28.39 || {V247}
analyzed: tasya eva paṭasya agratas kapilāyāḥ samāna vatsāyāḥ go ghṛtam gṛhya tāmra bhājane sthāpya tāvat japet yāvat ūṣmāyati dhūmāyati prajvalati ūṣmāyamānam pītvā parama medhāvī bhavati śrutidharaḥ dhūmāyamāne ntardhānam jvalamāne ākāśa gamanam āma śarāva sampuṭe sthāpya vacām jātī kusumaiḥ veṣṭayitvā tāvat japet yāvat aṅkurībhavati tām bhakṣayitvā śrutidharaḥ bhavati anyām koṭim japet mañjuśriyam sākṣāt paśyati dharma deśayitvā

original: sauvarṇapadmaṃ śatapatraṃ kārayitvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tāvaj japed yāvaj jvalatīti | tena gṛhītamātreṇa vidyādharāṇāṃ cakravartī bhavati parair adharṣaṇīyaḥ | manaḥśilāṃ haritālam añjanaṃ vā śrīparṇīsamudgake prakṣipya tāvaj japed yāvat khuṭkhuṭāśabdaṃ karoti | gṛhītamātreṇa bhūmicarāṇāṃ rākṣasapiśācānām adhipatir bhavaty adhṛṣyaḥ || 28.40 ||
analyzed: sauvarṇa padmam śata patram kārayitvā dakṣiṇam jānu maṇḍalam pṛthivyām pratiṣṭhāpya tāvat japet yāvat jvalati iti tena gṛhīta mātreṇa vidyādharāṇām cakravartī bhavati paraiḥ a dharṣaṇīyaḥ manaḥśilām haritālam añjanam vā śrīparṇī samudgake prakṣipya tāvat japet yāvat khuṭkhuṭā śabdam karoti gṛhīta mātreṇa bhūmicarāṇām rākṣasa piśācānām adhipatiḥ bhavati adhṛṣyaḥ

original: khaḍgaṃ gṛhya sallakṣaṇasaṅkīrṇam avraṇaṃ tāvaj japed yāvad ahir iva phaṇaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhati | taṃ gṛhya vidyādharacakravartī kalpāyur adhṛṣyaḥ | manaḥśilāṃ trilohapariveṣṭitāṃ kṛtvā mukhe prakṣipya tāvaj japed yāvac culuculāyatīti | adṛśyo bhavati khaḍgahartā | adṛśyaḥ sarvāṇi kuśalopasaṃhitāni karoti varjayitvā kāmopasaṃhitam | śamīvṛkṣarūḍhasyāśvatthasya sāraṃ gṛhya trilohapariveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā mukhe prakṣipya tāvaj japed yāvac culuculāyati | adhṛṣyo bhavati | varṣasahasraṃ jīvati || 28.41 ||

original: aṅguṣṭhāgraiś calitair anāmikā parāmṛjyotkarṣayed āvāhanam | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | namo bhagavate • apratihatoṣṇīṣāya | ehi ehi bhagavan dharmarāja | pratīccheyam arghyaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ balyaṃ dīpaṃ ca | māṃ cābhirakṣa | apratihatabalaparākramāya svāhā | āvāhanaṃ śuklapuṣpaiḥ svarūpeṇārghyapādyam ācamanīyam āsanopaviśane tadānenaiva diśi vidiśi adha ūrdhvaṃ ca bandhayet || 37.18 ||
analyzed: aṅguṣṭha agraiḥ calitaiḥ anāmikā parāmṛjya utkarṣayet āvāhanam mantram ca atra bhavati namaḥ bhagavate apratihata uṣṇīṣāya ehi ehi bhagavan dharmarāja pratīccheyam arghyam gandham puṣpam dhūpam balyam dīpam ca mām ca abhirakṣa apratihata bala parākramāya svāhā āvāhanam śukla puṣpaiḥ sva rūpeṇa arghya pādyam ācamanīyam āsana upaviśane tadā anena eva diśi vidiśi adhas ūrdhvam ca bandhayet

original: tā evānāmikau aṅguṣṭhāgrair apamṛjyātha nāmayet madhyame parve | spṛśyotkṣipet | visarjanārgheṇa svadevatāyā apasavyena bhrāmayet | mudrā diśābandhā muktā bhavanti | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | namo 'pratihatoṣṇīṣāya gaccha gaccha bhagavan dharmarāja pratīccha mayārghyaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ māṃ ca rakṣa | apratihatabalaparākramāya svāhā | mudrāmantravisarjanārgheṇa || 37.19 ||
analyzed: tāḥ eva anāmikau aṅguṣṭha agraiḥ apamṛjya atha nāmayet madhyame parve spṛśya utkṣipet visarjana argheṇa sva devatāyāḥ apasavyena bhrāmayet mudrāḥ diśābandhāḥ muktāḥ bhavanti mantram ca atra bhavati namo pratihata uṣṇīṣāya gaccha gaccha bhagavan dharmarāja pratīccha mayā arghyam gandham puṣpam dhūpam mām ca rakṣa apratihata bala parākramāya svāhā mudrā mantra visarjana argheṇa

original: tā eva pradeśinyau • adhastāt tṛtīye parve madhyamasūcye saṃsaktāu | anyonya aṅguṣṭau saha kanyasair niṣpīḍitamuṣṭiḥ | madhyamasūcyau | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | namo bhagavate • apratihatoṣṇīṣāya oṁ oṁ hrauṁ bandha hūṁ phaṭ | apratihatoṣṇīṣatejorāśer mudrāmantrā sarvabandhādiṣūpayujyate sarvakarmikaḥ || 37.20 ||
analyzed: tāḥ eva pradeśinyau adhastāt tṛtīye parve madhyama sūcye saṃsaktau anyonya aṅguṣṭau saha kanyasaiḥ niṣpīḍita muṣṭiḥ madhyama sūcyau mantram ca atra bhavati namaḥ bhagavate apratihata uṣṇīṣāya om om bandha hūṃ phaṭ apratihata uṣṇīṣa tejaḥ rāśeḥ mudrā mantrā sarva bandha ādiṣu upayujyate sarva karmikaḥ

original: tā eva pradeśinyau • ākuñcitāgrā madhyamasūcyā tṛtīyaparve-dīṣidasaṃsaktā vikaraṇoṣṇīṣamudrā | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | namo bhagavate apratihatoṣṇīṣāya vikaraṇa dhuna dhuna hūṁ | vikaraṇoṣṇīṣaḥ • bhagavato vidyādhipater mahāvidyārājā • uṣṇīṣatantre sarvavighnavināyakopaghotaṣv abhiṣekam ātmarakṣādiśābandhamaṇḍalabandhādiṣu sarvakarmeṣu prayujyate || 37.21 || {S415}
analyzed: tāḥ eva pradeśinyau ākuñcita agrāḥ madhyama sūcyā vikaraṇa uṣṇīṣa mudrāḥ mantram ca atra bhavati namaḥ bhagavate apratihata uṣṇīṣāya vikaraṇa dhuna dhuna hūṃ vikaraṇa uṣṇīṣaḥ bhagavataḥ vidyā adhipateḥ mahāvidyā rājā uṣṇīṣa tantre abhiṣekam ātma rakṣā diśā bandha maṇḍalabandha ādiṣu sarva karmeṣu prayujyate

original: tā eva pradeśinyau vikasitākuñcitāgrā calitākṛṣṭau • agner āvāhanaṃ paścād dhomayāmīti | {V322} eṣa eva visarjanaṃ vikṣiptaiḥ pradeśinyau | jvālāmālinoṣṇīṣamudrā | apratihataḥ sarvakarmasu | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | namo bhagavate • apratihatoṣṇīṣāya ehy ehi tejomāline • agnaye svāhā || 37.22 ||
analyzed: tāḥ eva pradeśinyau vikasitā ākuñcita agrā calitā ākṛṣṭau agneḥ āvāhanam paścāt homayāmi iti eṣaḥ eva visarjanam vikṣiptaiḥ pradeśinyau jvālā mālinā uṣṇīṣa mudrāḥ apratihataḥ sarva karmasu mantram ca atra bhavati namaḥ bhagavate apratihata uṣṇīṣāya ehi ehi tejaḥ māline agnaye svāhā

original: tā eva pradeśinyau • ākuñcitāgrā madhyamasūcyā tṛtīye parve madhyamaparvayor antare saṃsaktā balotkaṭoṣṇīṣamudrā | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | namo bhagavate • apratihatoṣṇīṣāya • imaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ baliṃ dīpaṃ ca pratīccha hara hara sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhite dharmarājāpratihatāya svāhā | gandhādiṣu mantraḥ || 37.23 ||
analyzed: tāḥ eva pradeśinyau ākuñcita agrāḥ madhyama sūcyā tṛtīye parve madhyama parvayoḥ antare saṃsaktāḥ bala utkaṭa uṣṇīṣa mudrāḥ mantram ca atra bhavati namaḥ bhagavate apratihata uṣṇīṣāya imam gandham puṣpam dhūpam balim dīpam ca pratīccha hara hara sarva buddha adhiṣṭhite dharmarāja apratihatāya svāhā gandha ādiṣu mantraḥ

original: ekāṅguli-m-ucchrite sarveṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ dvipadacatuṣpadabahupadāpadatribhavasaṃsthitānāṃ sattvānāṃ mudrā bhavati | dvir ucchritai sarveṣāṃ yakṣayakṣīṇāṃ mudrā bhavati | trim ucchritaiḥ

original: sarvavidyādharavidyādharīṇāṃ mudrā bhavati | catur ucchritaiḥ samapāṇitalavinyastaiḥ sasurāsurāṅganānāṃ mudrā bhavati || 37.60 ||

original: kṛtāñjalivinyastau hastau śobhanākārasaṃsthitau sarveṣāṃ rūpādhacarāṇāṃ {V325} devānāṃ mudrā bhavati | tad eva hastau • ārupyādhacarāṇāṃ devānāṃ mudrā bhavati || 37.61 ||

original: tad eva hastau suṣirasampuṭākārau muṣṭinibandhanau kāmadhātveśvaraprabhṛtīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmadhātusthitānāṃ sanaratiryakpretayāmalaukikānāṃ sattvānāṃ mudrā bhavati || 37.62 ||

original: tām eva mudrām ekam aṅgulim utsṛjya sarveṣāṃ piśācapiśācīnāṃ mudrā bhavati | dvim utsṛtai rākṣasarākṣasīnām | trim utsṛtaiḥ sarvakravyādādīnāṃ grahamātarakūṣmāṇḍādīnāṃ piśitāśināṃ sarveṣāṃ ca ḍākinīnāṃ vyantarādīnāṃ ca sakaśmalām | caturbhir aṅgulībhiḥ saṅkucitaiḥ sarvakaśmalāṃ mudrā bhavati || 37.63 ||
analyzed: tām eva mudrām ekam aṅgulim utsṛjya sarveṣām piśāca piśācīnām mudrā bhavati dvim utsṛtaiḥ rākṣasa rākṣasīnām trim utsṛtaiḥ sarva kravyāda ādīnām graha mātara kūṣmāṇḍa ādīnām piśita āśinām sarveṣām ca ḍākinīnām vyantara ādīnām ca sa kaśmalām caturbhiḥ aṅgulībhiḥ saṅkucitaiḥ sarva kaśmalām mudrā bhavati

original: mudrair ākṛṣṭair ākarṣaṇam | mudrair utkṣiptair visarjanam | svacittena sarvakarmāṇi kārayet | ebhir eva mudrair yatheṣṭataḥ svakaṃ svakaṃ mantraṃ niyojayet | nānyeṣāṃ nānyakarmāṇi kārayet | tasmin tasmin niyuñjyād yasmin yasmin mantrā bhavanti || 37.64 ||

original: anullaṅghyā hy ete mudrā sarvabuddhair adhiṣṭhitā | aśaktā sarvasattvā vai mudrāṃ dṛṣṭvāpi kopitum || 37.65 ||

original: mudrolaṅghanād vināśam āpnuvanti | mudrāṇāṃ vināśāt samayabhraṃśaḥ sarvavidyāvyatikramaś ca niṣṭhāyāṃ raurave gatir avīcyāyāṃ vā mahānarakopapattir gāḍhataram evāpnuvanti vighnakartāro | ye ca mudrāsamayam adhitiṣṭhante teṣāṃ cirasaukhyam analpakaṃ bhavati mahādivaukasopapattiś ca gatiniṣṭhāyāṃ niyataṃ bodhiparāyaṇo bhavati || 37.66 ||
analyzed: mudrā ulaṅghanāt vināśam āpnuvanti mudrāṇām vināśāt samaya bhraṃśaḥ sarva vidyā vyatikramaḥ ca niṣṭhāyām raurave gatiḥ avīcyāyām vā mahānaraka upapattiḥ gāḍhataram eva āpnuvanti vighna kartāraḥ ye ca mudrā samayam adhitiṣṭhante teṣām cira saukhyam analpakam bhavati mahā divaukasa upapattiḥ ca gati niṣṭhāyām niyatam bodhi parāyaṇaḥ bhavati

original: saṃkṣepato mudrā bahuprakārā prakāśitā ādibuddhair bodhisattvaiś ca maharddhikaiḥ | na śakyam asya paryantaṃ gantuṃ saṅkhyāgaṇanāṃ vā kartuṃ sarvasattvaiś ca udgrahītum || 37.67 ||
analyzed: saṃkṣepataḥ mudrā bahu prakārā prakāśitā ādibuddhaiḥ bodhisattvaiḥ ca maharddhikaiḥ na śakyam asya paryantam gantum saṅkhyā gaṇanām vā kartum sarva sattvaiḥ ca udgrahītum

analyzed: saṃkṣepataḥ jina kule vidyā rāja cakravarti ekam akṣaram rakṣā artham tasya mudrā bhavati vāma itarasya pūrvam muṣṭim kṛtvā madhyamāṅguli yugalam pramuñcet prasṛtam kṛtvā ekatas ubhayoḥ api ekam parva kuñcayet tarjanī yugalam dvi parva kuñcitaḥ anyonya nakha saṃyuktam aṅguṣṭha nakha upari dhārayet eṣa cakravarti mudrā sarva karmikā pravarā sarva mudrāṇām nirdiṣṭā lokatāyibhiḥ 3768 anupūrva anupūrva anupūrva anupūrva anupūrva anupūrva anu

original: padmadharamudrāyāḥ • ekākṣarāvalokiteśvarahṛdayena saṃyuktaḥ sarvakarmāṃ karoti | paṇḍaravāsinyā vā vidyāmudreṇa vā saṃyuktā tathaiva sarvakarmāṃ karoti | vajradharasya mudrāyā tasyaiva • ekākṣarahṛdayena saṃyuktaḥ tathaiva sarvakarmāṃ karoti | māmakyā vā mahāvidyayā || 37.71 ||
analyzed: padmadhara mudrāyāḥ ekākṣara avalokiteśvara hṛdayena saṃyuktaḥ sarva karmām karoti paṇḍaravāsinyā vā vidyāmudreṇa vā saṃyuktā tathā eva sarva karmām karoti vajradharasya mudrāyā tasya eva ekākṣara hṛdayena saṃyuktaḥ tathā eva sarva karmām karoti māmakyā vā mahāvidyayā

original: evaṃ rājakule • ekākṣararājagandhabodhisattvahṛdayena evaṃ tenaiva mudrāyā maṇikule yakṣakule divye • ārye | teṣv iha • ekākṣarahṛdayais teṣv eva mudraiḥ sarvakarmāṇi kartavyāni | evaṃ sarvatra sarvamudraiḥ sarvamantraiś ca sarvakarmāṇi kartavyāni | yathāyuktitaḥ vidyāmantrabalādhānā nyaset | nānyataḥ karmāṇi kartavyāni || 37.72 || {V326}

original: evaṃ dakṣiṇakaravinyastaṃ svastyodyataḥ • brāhmaṇasya sahāmpateḥ | ekaliṅgamudrāyā maheśvarasya | cakramudrāyā viṣṇoḥ | añjali-rākośaviralavinyastaḥ • garutmanaḥ | evaṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ śāpodyatahastamudrām | evaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sasurāsurāṇāṃ vāmahasta-m-aṅguṣṭham abhyantarīkṛtamukham upadarśanamuṣṭisthitam | catuḥkumāryamudrā tenaiva mantreṇa || 37.73 ||

analyzed: eṣā vikāsinī mantra anena mudreṇa saṃyuktā sarva karmikā bhavati graha āviṣṭānām prajñāpayati jalpāpayati graha gṛhītām kravyāda kaśmala gṛhītānām viṣa mūrchitānām vā yathā yathā prayujyate tathā tathā tat sarvam karoti eṣa saṃkṣepataḥ sarva artha saṃsādhanī vidyā vikāsinyā mudrayā yuktā asiddhā ca kṣipram artham karoti

original: hastadvayasampuṭaṃ kṛtvā • antaritāṅgulisamaṃ kārayet | hṛdayamudrā | hṛdayaṃ saptavārān hṛdayam abhimantrya moktavyā | evaṃ sarvatra | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | oṁ godare vīra svāhā | tathāgatahṛdaya || 37.80 || {S422}

original: dakṣiṇahastenāṅguṣṭhaṃ muktaṃ muṣṭiṃ baddhvā khakharakamudrā | mantraṃ cātra bhavati | oṁ dhuna ajitaraṇa hūṁ | khakharakamantrā sarvakarmikaḥ || 37.82 || {V327}

analyzed: anena eva mudrayā vāmam cīvara saṃsaktam kṛtvā cīvara mudrā mantram ca atra bhavati oṃ rakṣa rakṣa sarva buddha adhiṣṭhita ātma cīvara svāhā tathāgata cīvaraḥ anena eva mudreṇa sarva karmām karoti cīvaram ca asya abhimantrya prāvaret subhagaḥ bhavati mahārakṣā kṛtā bhavati sarva graha mātara piśita āśina kravyādasa kaśmalā sarva vighnāḥ ca dṛṣṭa mātrā prapalāyante

analyzed: vāma aṅguṣṭha dakṣiṇa kaniṣṭhikā anyonya āsaktau kṛtvā adhas hasta sampuṭa ādhāraḥ pātra mudrā mantram ca atra bhavati oṃ lokapāla dhiṣṭhita dhara dhāraya mahā anubhāva buddha pātra svāhā anena eva mudreṇa ayam mantraḥ saṃyuktā sarva karmikāḥ bhojana kāle smartavyaḥ sarva gara viṣāḥ na prabhavanti

original: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyo 'rhadbhyaḥ samyaksambuddhebhyaḥ | oṁ kumārarūpiṇe viśvasambhava • āgacchāgaccha | lahu lahu bhrūṃ bhrūṃ hūṃ hūṃ jinajit • mañjuśrīye suśriye tāraya māṃ sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ phaṭ phaṭ śamaya śamaya | amṛtodbhavodbhavapāpaṃ me nāśaya svāhā || 54.100 ||
analyzed: namaḥ sarva tathāgatebhyaḥ rhadbhyaḥ samyaksambuddhebhyaḥ oṁ kumāra rūpiṇe viśva sambhava āgaccha āgaccha lahu lahu bhrūm bhrūm hūm hūm jina jit mañjuśrīye suśriye tāraya mām sarva duḥkhebhyaḥ phaṭ phaṭ śamaya śamaya amṛta udbhava udbhava pāpam me nāśaya svāhā

original: eṣa mañjuśrīs tvadīyaṃ paramahṛdayaṃ sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ sarvaduḥkhapramocanam āyurārogyaiśvaryaparamasaubhāgyavākyasañjananaṃ sarvavidyārājasattejanaṃ ca | samanantarabhāṣite śākyamuninā buddhena bhagavatā • iyaṃ mahāpṛthivī saśailasāgarasattvabhājanasannicayaparyantā ṣaḍvikāraṃ prakampati bhābhūt | sarvāś ca gatayaḥ pretatiryagyamalokasarvasattvaduḥkhāni pratipraśrabdhāni || 54.101 ||
analyzed: eṣa mañjuśrīḥ tvadīyam parama hṛdayam sarva śānti karam sarva pāpa kṣayam sarva duḥkha pramocanam āyuḥ ārogya aiśvarya parama saubhāgya vākya sañjananam sarva vidyā rāja sattejanam ca samanantara bhāṣite śākyamuninā buddhena bhagavatā iyam mahā pṛthivī sa śaila sāgara sattva bhājana sannicaya paryantā ṣaṣ vikāram prakampati sarvāḥ ca gatayaḥ preta tiryagyama loka sarva sattva duḥkhāni pratipraśrabdhāni

original: ayaṃ ca vidyārājā mañjuśrīr manasi kartavyaḥ • na ca tasmin samaye saddharmapratikṣepeṇa cittaṃ bhaveyuḥ | na ca mārāḥ pāpīyāṃsaḥ • avatāraṃ lapsante | sarvavighnavināyakāś cāpakramante | evaṃ ca cittam utpādayitavyam kiṃ mayā śakyaṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatām acintyabuddhā bodhidharmā cintayituṃ vā pratikṣeptuṃ vā buddhā bhagavanto jñāsyantīti || 54.102 ||
analyzed: ayam ca vidyā rājā mañjuśrīḥ manasi kartavyaḥ na ca tasmin samaye saddharma pratikṣepeṇa cittam bhaveyuḥ na ca mārāḥ pāpīyāṃsaḥ avatāram lapsante sarva vighna vināyakāḥ ca apakramante evam ca cittam utpādayitavyam kim mayā śakyam buddhānām bhagavatām acintya buddhāḥ bodhi dharmāḥ cintayitum vā pratikṣeptum vā buddhāḥ bhagavantaḥ jñāsyanti iti

original: āryamañjuśrīmūlakalpād bodhisattvapiṭakāvaṃtaṃsakān mahāyānavaipulyasūtrāc catuḥpañcāśo 'nuśaṃsāvigarhaṇaprabhāvapaṭalavisaraḥ parisamāpta iti || {V523}
analyzed: ārya mañjuśrī mūla kalpāt bodhisattva piṭaka avaṃtaṃsakāt mahāyāna vaipulya sūtrāt catuḥpañcāśaḥ nuśaṃsā vigarhaṇa prabhāva paṭala visaraḥ parisamāptaḥ iti

original: parisamāptaṃ ca yathālabdham āryamañjuśriyasya kalpam iti ||
analyzed: parisamāptam ca yathālabdham ārya mañjuśriyasya kalpam iti
